definitions.gloss: luxury goods, high-end product, premium item
definitions.explanation: A product or item of high quality and high price, often associated with prestigious brands or superior craftsmanship.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{高級品|こうきゅうひん}ばかり{扱|あつか}っている。
examples.english: This store deals only in luxury goods.

examples.japanese: {高級品|こうきゅうひん}だからといって{必|かなら}ずしも{質|しつ}がいいわけではない。
examples.english: Just because something is a luxury item doesn't necessarily mean it's high quality.

examples.japanese: {円安|えんやす}の{影響|えいきょう}で、{海外|かいがい}からの{観光客|かんこうきゃく}が{高級品|こうきゅうひん}を{大量|たいりょう}に{購入|こうにゅう}している。
examples.english: Due to the weak yen, tourists from overseas are buying luxury goods in large quantities.

notes:
A compound of {高級|こうきゅう} (high-class, luxury) and {品|ひん} (goods, item). A straightforward term that covers any premium product, from fashion and watches to food and electronics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高級品|こうきゅうひん}を{買|か}う: to buy luxury goods
- {高級品|こうきゅうひん}{市場|しじょう}: luxury goods market
- {高級品|こうきゅうひん}ブランド: luxury brand
- {高級品|こうきゅうひん}{志向|しこう}: preference for luxury goods

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {贅沢品|ぜいたくひん}: luxury item — emphasizes extravagance, can carry a slightly negative nuance of wastefulness
- {高級|こうきゅう}: high-class, luxury — the adjective/noun form without {品|ひん}
- {一流品|いちりゅうひん}: first-class product — emphasizes top-tier quality
